description: This file defines functions for migrating LED sysfs configurations and applying configuration changes in a Linux-based system. It includes functions to update sysfs paths and remove device name prefixes from sysfs entries, as well as orchestrating the migration process.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates sysfs path entries for LEDs based on provided old and new tuple mappings.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes device name prefixes from sysfs entries unless they are in the exception list.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies led sysfs migrations.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and removes device name prefixes from LEDs.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Applies configuration changes in a specified realm if there are unapplied changes.
